title: add RAG agent quickstarts, tool-calling examples, and docs site updates
author: Asha Raman
description: Add a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) templates and agent/tool-calling quickstarts + docs site updates. This PR introduces: 1) three opinionated RAG prompt templates (faq, long-context, and citation-aware) with example configs; 2) two agent examples demonstrating tool-calling patterns (search+call, and structured tool outputs) implemented in TypeScript and Python; 3) quickstart guides and runnable notebooks; 4) docs site updates to include the new quickstarts, config reference, and a short migration note for existing RAG users. Motivation: reduce onboarding time for engineers adopting RAG workflows and provide canonical patterns for tool calling and structured outputs that match Redwood runtime semantics. Checklist: - [x] RAG templates implemented and unit-tested - [x] Agent examples (ts/py) with README + tests - [x] Docs site pages added and linked from Quickstarts index - [x] CI green on tests and linters - [x] Verified examples run end-to-end with sandbox credentials Notes on compatibility: examples use the new tool-calling helpers in redwood-sdk-typescript v0.9.0 and redwood-sdk-python v0.15. Suggested follow-ups: add a Recorded demo video and extend templates with multi-modal retrieval. Related Linear: ENG-4321, PM-987
